description: This file defines an interface for managing interest pause periods on loans, including creating, deleting, and updating interest pauses identified by either internal or external loan IDs.

classes.name: InterestPauseWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for creating, deleting, and updating interest pause periods on loans, identified by internal or external IDs.

methods.name: createInterestPause
methods.description: Creates a new interest pause period for a loan, identified by external or internal ID, with specified start and end dates, date format, and locale.

methods.name: deleteInterestPause
methods.description: Deletes an existing interest pause period for a loan, identified by internal or external ID.

methods.name: updateInterestPause
methods.description: Updates an existing interest pause period for a loan, identified by internal or external ID, with new start and end dates.
